Task automation enhances jobs and reduces inequality by lowering the skill premium — opening tasks locked behind rare skills to a wider pool.

## Social contract scores (draft)

| Promise | Score | Reason |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Hard work pays | 4 | Automation opens tasks once locked behind rare skills to a wider pool, so effort pays for more people. |
| Affordable essentials | 3 | Lower skill premiums do little on their own for housing, food, energy or care. |
| Reliable safety net | 3 | Narrower inequality eases pressure on the safety net without changing its design. |
| Responsive government | 3 | Institutions carry on much as now. |
| Time for what matters | 3 | Little change to working hours or time for family and community. |
